brief.claim: In each participant's own region of visual cortex that responds more to faces than to houses, the response to faces exceeds the response to bodies: across the 12 participants the mean difference (faces minus bodies) of the response in that region is at least 0.3 percent signal change, and a one-sided paired t test across participants is significant at the 0.05 level.
